card.name: Adaptation and coping strategies in organisms
card.fires_on: Words about how organisms or communities adapt or cope, such as developed, strategies and mechanisms, in passages on adaptation to harsh conditions like altitude, cold, or infection.

modes.label: Developed adaptations
modes.description: The verb developed or have after an animal subject, just before a description of an adaptation.
modes.example: Animals have<< developed>> physiological adaptations to enhance oxygen uptake and delivery

modes.label: Strategies and mechanisms
modes.description: Nouns like strategies or mechanisms that follow adaptation, coping or survival.
modes.example: AMPs can stimulate bacterial survival<< mechanisms>> leading to persistent infections.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like mechanism, mechanisms, reserves and compens(ation), which name coping or adaptive processes.
card.plain: It lights up when text describes how living things adapt or cope with hard conditions, at words like developed, strategies and mechanisms.
